lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Rocco Warren is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Rocco is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d40: 🕯️ Rocco Warren is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Rocco kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Rocco's gone." Marcus looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Rocco." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Quinn blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Generous Heart (Level 1). Donating gives 2x trust.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Reading People (Level 1). Microexpressions leak truth. Watch the eyes, not the mouth. People tell you who they are.
d40: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Deep Read! You don't just read trust — you read intent. Know what they'll do next. (Your knowledge of Reading People amplifies your open_book.)
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Keeping Morale (Level 1). People need small wins. Celebrate the little things. Despair is the real killer.

d40: 📖 LEARNED: Come Get Some (Level 1). Make exactly the right noise and the blind thing comes to investigate. Goad a blinded monster within 3 tiles: it lurches toward the sound on its next move. Stand where you want it.

d40: The warm hum behind your ribs is gone. The reactor went with Rocco's body — it does not come out, and it does not pass on. Hunger is back on the table. (One reactor per world, and the world already spent its one.)
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Rocco Warren, 40 days. The mantle passes to Quinn Murphy.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Quinn Murphy, 25 — a bartender. Her hands know different work now: Green Whisper, War Cry, Green Thumb, Literally.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Rocco — and Rocco is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Kayden, Hilda, Paloma and 4 more speak for Quinn — "Rocco trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Quinn before the Codex did — her name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d110: 🍽️ Hilda carries the day's surplus to the pantry door, thinks better of it, and turns back to the fire. "It'll only rot in there. We eat."
